pages.text: Mill rice into $(item)polished rice$() and steam it in a kettle of water (no bowl). Two steamed rice in a jar somewhere Warm grow into two $(item)koji rice$() in two days.
Stir 2 koji rice a bucket into a heated kettle of water for $(item)sake mash$(). Ferment it Cool with Wine Yeast, and bottle the $(item)sake$() in wine bottles.
